fact: The Agence de Modernisation des Villes issued tender notice PI_DG_009, closing 30 June 2025, for updating and extending Niamey's urban addressing system.

The Agence de Modernisation des Villes says its Niamey addressing geoportal, built by GéoMinds Africa with city-validated data, references 3,500+ streets of the capital, to modernise the traditional addressing system.
